# Bridge callback completion to a Promise before starting the OAuth window flow

The standalone tests create a window promise and a Promise.withResolvers pair before getAccessToken, then route onSuccess/onFailure to resolve/reject and await that promise. Proposed pattern in this test family: arm observers and completion handling before triggering the asynchronous action. It makes failures assertable and avoids confusing a shown window with completed authorization. The production OAuth API has since changed internally, so this note describes the test boundary. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.

Scope: OAuth asynchronous tests.
